messages:
Jamie: :rotating_light: incidentbot autopage for metrics pipeline - PD alert fired: prometheus_rule 'MetricsPipeline_ScrapeFailure' in eu-west-1. Noticed high scrape error rate for app-metrics-exporter, multiple 5xxs. Anyone oncall?
PagerDuty Bot: PagerDuty incident INC-48291 created and routed to SRE on-call. Escalation policy: metrics-pipeline.
oncallbot: @SRE-oncall paging Jamie (primary). Please ack.
Priya: acked. Looking now. Can you paste the alert details?
Jamie: alert payload:
```
labels:
  alertname: MetricsPipeline_ScrapeFailure
  region: eu-west-1
  exporter: app-metrics-exporter
annotations:
  summary: Prometheus scrape failures > 5m
  runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-OPS-123
```
Jamie: Prom query shows scrape_errors_total rate jumped 10x around 11:03 UTC. exporter OOM logs in previous deploy?
Carlos: I can see spikes on scrape_error_count{exporter="app-metrics-exporter"} from 11:02 -> 11:15. Also log-ingest lag metric log_ingest_queue_length increased from 2k -> 18k for shard eu-west-1 at same time.
Devon: looks like the exporter is returning 500s intermittently. I pulled last few logs from the exporter pod: `java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space` then restart.
Priya: that's consistent. Customer dashboards dependent on these metrics will show missing time series and some alerts are noisy. Any live customer reports?
Jamie: Support: two customers filed slow dashboard tickets earlier. Internal alert: 10% of aggregations delayed past SLA.
Carlos: mitigation plan: 1) Silence the Prometheus rule to stop PD thrash while we fix 2) Enable temporary scrape_fallback to a standby exporter pool in us-west for critical metrics 3) Scale exporter deployment to +2 replicas 4) Backfill missing metrics if necessary.
Priya: I'll silence the alert for 30m. Running Alertmanager silence now: 
```
curl -XPOST -sS "https://alertmanager.redwood.internal/api/v2/silences" -d '{"matchers":[{"name":"alertname","value":"MetricsPipeline_ScrapeFailure","isRegex":false}],"startsAt":"2026-03-15T11:18:00Z","endsAt":"2026-03-15T11:48:00Z","createdBy":"Priya","comment":"Mute while we triage exporter OOM and scale"}'
```
Priya: silence created (id: s-8f3a). Confirming PD will not re-auto-page for same alert.
PagerDuty Bot: Incident INC-48291 acknowledged by Priya.
Devon: I'm rolling a quick HPA-style bump: `kubectl scale deploy app-metrics-exporter --replicas=3 -n metrics`. Also adding JVM Xmx bump in staging config and will push to canary.
Carlos: I'll add a temporary scrape relabel to route critical targets to exporter-canary group: editing scrape_config in scrape-proxy. Patch: `- job_name: 'app-metrics-critical' ... relabel_configs: - source_labels: ['__meta_kubernetes_service_label_critical'] keep: 'true'`
Jamie: Good. Priya, heads-up: will handoff to Maya at 12:00 UTC (20 min from now). Please summarize status before handoff.
Priya: Summary for handoff: exporter OOM causing 5xx scrape responses in eu-west-1 since ~11:02 UTC -> PD incident created. Mitigations applied: alert muted for 30m, exporter scaled to 3 replicas, temporary relabel to route critical scrapes to canary, canary JVM Xmx increased and monitoring for OOM. Backfill plan queued (RW-OPS-124). Customer impact: degraded dashboards for ~2 customers, aggregation latency ~10% above SLA. Next steps: monitor for 15m, if errors persist rollback last deploy and open RCA.
Maya: taking over at 12:00 UTC. Thanks Priya. I'll watch for recurring PD pages and coordinate support comms.
Carlos: quick note - we saw 1 pod crashloop back to back with OOM, image tag `v2.14.1` rolled out at 10:55 UTC. Suggest pinning to `v2.14.0` if instability continues. Creating a short rollback PR.
Devon: monitoring metrics: scrape_error_rate now down to baseline after scale/relabeled routing. log_ingest_queue_length decreased to ~3k. Still higher than normal; watching.
PagerDuty Bot: INC-48291 reassigned to Maya (on-call).
Jamie: nice work team. Create post-incident ticket for RCA, include heap dump analysis and deployment gating fix. Also add action to add exporter OOM probe to canary and alert on restart_count > 1 within 5m.
Priya: Created follow-up Jira RW-OPS-125 (RCA) and RW-OPS-126 (Alert tuning). I'll add notes and attach logs + heapdump link.
Maya: I'll start a short postmortem draft in the incidents channel after we confirm stability. If anybody sees PD re-flares, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Jamie: closing thread for now, will reopen if PD pages again.
